<notes>
kept -> base1 -> correct answer "AC, AC" delivered in 1 call; main question correctly identified A (referee sightlines) and C (broadcasting impact); sub-question correctly identified A (rotation ensures serving opportunity) and C (skill development). No systematic failure, no repeated error, no mechanical issue requiring extraction.

kept -> inv1 and dom1 candidates identical to base -> both proposed no code changes (diff: "no change"). Both rollouts produced wrong answers: inv1 gave "A, CD" (rejected C incorrectly, rejected A for sub-Q incorrectly); dom1 gave "AC, CD" (rejected A for sub-Q incorrectly, reasoning both times that A was not "fundamental" when the task asks for "all correct choices"). The wrong outputs in inv1 and dom1 are model variance on identical code, not evidence that the base harness is defective. The base harness works correctly.

rejected -> both candidate changes -> inv1 and dom1 decisions both concluded KEEP_BASE with no FILE blocks. Both candidates are identical to base (no changes). The base delivered the correct answer once. No evidence supports any edit.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
